name: Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 21, 2020 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Analyst McShane
Approve the Warrants.
2020-10-21 Item 08A Warrants
8B.
Assistance by Hire (ABH) Agreement with the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL Fire). Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
Authorize the City Manager, on behalf of the City, to execute an addendum to the Assistance by Hire (ABH) Agreement in substantial form, in consultation with the City Attorney, as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, with the California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection (CAL Fire) for the continued assistance of personnel on the County of San Diego Type-6 Fire Engine at Encinitas Station #6 and assistance of personnel/equipment from other Encinitas fire stations for State and County mission operational duties.
2020-10-21 Item 08B Assistance by Hire Agreeement - CALFire
8C.
Construction Contract Award to Granite Construction Company; Construction Support Contract Approvals for Psomas, Michael Baker International, and Peltz and Associates; Budget Adjustment Approval and Local Project Participant (LPP) Agreement Approval between the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) and the City of Encinitas for the Proposition 84 Integrated Regional Water Management (IRWM) Implementation Grant for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
Recommended Actions:
1)
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 1 (of the agenda report) and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Granite Construction Company in the amount of $6,411,891 plus 15 percent contingency ($961,784) to construct the Base Bid and Additive Alternates 1, 2, 3 and 4 for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project, at a total cost to construct construction not-to-exceed amount of $7,373,675.
2)
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract in substantial form as shown in Attachment 2 (of the agenda report) and any necessary amendments and time extensions, in consultation with the City Attorney, with Psomas in the amount of $995,374 plus 15 percent contingency ($149,306) for a total not-to-exceed amount of $1,144,680 for construction management services for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D).
3)
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 3 (of the agenda report), in consultation with the City Attorney, with project designer Michael Baker International (MBI) in the amount of $198,700 plus 15 percent contingency ($29,805), for a total contract amendment not to exceed amount of $228,505 for roadway design construction support services for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project.
4)
Authorize the City Manager or designee to execute a contract amendment and time extensions, in substantial form as included in Attachment 4 (of the agenda report), in consultation with the City Attorney, with landscape designer Peltz and Associates in the amount of $85,960 plus 15 percent contingency ($12,894), for a total contract amendment not to exceed amount of $98,854 for landscape design construction support for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project.
5)
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2020-89, entitled “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2020-21 Budget” (Attachment 5 of the agenda report) to allocate $1,361,865 to the Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D).
6)
Authorize the City Manager, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute a new Local Project Participant (LPP) Agreement (Attachment 6 of the agenda report) between the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) and the City of Encinitas for the Proposition 84 Integrated Regional Water Management (IRWM) Implementation Grant to reallocate $179,865 to Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape project.
2020-10-21 Item 08C Construction Contract Award Streetscape Phase 1
8D.
Amendment to add communication services for the Leucadia Streetscape Project Phase 1 to the JPW Communications, LLC Agreement. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Piatt
Authorize the City Manager to execute a contract amendment in substantial form as contained in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, in conjunction with the City Attorney, adding $90,000 to the existing JPW Agreement for a contract not-to-exceed total of $244,545 if all contract extensions are executed.
2020-10-21 Item 08D Amendment to JPW Communications Agreement
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
8C.
Construction Contract Award to Granite Construction Company; Construction Support Contract Approvals for Psomas, Michael Baker International, and Peltz and Associates; Budget Adjustment Approval and Local Project Participant (LPP) Agreement Approval between the San Elijo Joint Powers Authority (SEJPA) and the City of Encinitas for the Proposition 84 Integrated Regional Water Management (IRWM) Implementation Grant for Phase 1 of the Leucadia Streetscape Project (CS04D). Contact Person: Principal Engineer Bankston
10A.
Introduction of City Council Ordinance No. 2020-10, which proposes amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan to update the Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) and Junior Accessory Dwelling Unit (JADU) development standards based on updates to State Law that became effective on January 1, 2020. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Introduce draft Ordinance No. 2020-10 titled, “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas, California, Adopting Amendments to Title 30 (Zoning) of the Encinitas Municipal Code to Address Changes in State Law Regarding Accessory Dwelling Units and Junior Accessory Dwelling Units” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report).
2020-10-21 Item 10A ADU Update Intro Ordinance
10B.
Status of the City’s Accessory Dwelling Unit (ADU) program initiatives and recommendations for increasing ADU production. Contact Person: Planner IV Plagemann
Review the information and provide direction to staff on incentive programs to increase ADU production in the City.
2020-10-21 Item 10B ADU Program Status Update
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS - NONE
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM - NONE
13.
CITY COUNCIL MEMBER REPORTS PURSUANT TO AB1234 (GC 53232.3(d)) / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF
14.
CITY MANAGER REPORTS
15.
CITY ATTORNEY REPORTS
16.
ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON OCTOBER 28, 2020
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
